name: watermark-remover
description: Strip AI-provenance watermarks (invisible characters, vendor signatures, EXIF/XMP/C2PA metadata, visual overlays) from text, files, and images. Adds a 'Clean AI watermarks' context menu on selected text, a 'Strip metadata' context menu on selected files, and three commands: cleanText, cleanFile, detectText. Delegates to the local `watermarkremover` CLI (or MCP server when registered) — no network calls, no remote services.

commands.title: WatermarkRemover: Clean AI watermarks from selection
WatermarkRemover: Strip metadata from selected file(s)
WatermarkRemover: Detect AI watermarks in selection

watermarkremover.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `watermarkremover` binary, or just the name to pick it up from `$PATH`. The extension spawns this binary to do the actual cleaning. Default: `watermarkremover` (assumes it's on `$PATH`). For source-mode development, set this to a wrapper script that calls `dotnet run --project /path/to/src/WatermarkRemover.CLI -- serve-mcp` or use the empty string and rely on `$PATH`.

watermarkremover.preferMcp.markdownDescription: When `true`, the extension will try to call the `watermarkremover` MCP server first (must be registered in VS Code's MCP hosts) before falling back to the CLI. The MCP path returns structured results; the CLI path pipes stdin/stdout. Default: `false` — CLI works out of the box without any extra MCP registration.

watermarkremover.statistical.markdownDescription: When `true`, the `cleanText` command also enables Layer B statistical / synonym-aware rewriting (EN + RU) in addition to the default Layer A Unicode hygiene. Equivalent to passing `--statistical` to `watermarkremover clean-text`. Use only when the user explicitly asks to 'humanise' or 'rewrite'.

watermarkremover.showNotifications.markdownDescription: When `true`, the extension shows a status-bar / information message after each clean / detect operation (with a count of removed characters, output file path, etc.). Set to `false` to silence the extension entirely.
